title: 25 FOR REASONS — Board 001
dek: The biggest move on the first Tuesday board is the one that did not happen: USC won 42-26 and stays at No. 10. Twenty-five holds, one game played, and a change receipt under every reason.
body:
Board 001 is the first Tuesday board of the season and it moves nothing. That is the point, not a shrug. Only one of the twenty-five had played by press time: USC beat San José State 42-26 at the Coliseum on Aug. 29, Jayden Maiava went 25 of 29 for 286 yards, and the Trojans stay at No. 10 because a comfortable win over a Mountain West opponent is the expected result. The three fourth-quarter touchdowns came against reserves, so the tackling question in USC’s proof line stays open.

The other twenty-four carry the preseason case forward unchanged, each with a new line under its reason: the opener, the date, and what that game can actually show. Clemson at LSU on Saturday is the one Week 1 game that can move two numbers on this board at once. Notre Dame meets Wisconsin at Lambeau Field on Sunday. Boise State walks into Autzen, which is exactly the logo its proof line asked for.

The movement rule is written down: a number moves only when a game shows something the case or doubt already named, and an expected win holds. Board 000 stays frozen with its hash on the season ledger; Board 001 sits beside it with its own. Board 002 lands Tuesday, Sept. 8 at 8:08 PT with the Labor Day weekend results. — cc
